subject: China and India
note: Hand-curated from the pinned World Bank series (public/geo/series.json, population, total). By the UN Population Division’s own estimate India passed China in 2023; the World Bank’s table, which the chart draws, crosses in 2021, so the episode says "by the World Bank’s count".

claims.text: In the World Bank’s population table, China had more people than any other country in every year from 1960 to 2020.
In 1960 China had 667 million people and India 436 million.
India’s population grew faster than China’s, narrowing the gap year after year.
India passed China in the World Bank’s table in 2021.
China’s population peaked in 2021 at 1.41 billion and has fallen every year since in the same table.
